  tecnologia = "This theme shows how widespread machinery, farming practices, electricity, technical guidance, financing and the PRONAF Eligibility Declaration (DAP) are among family farms (IBGE, 2017 Agricultural Census).",

```{r}
faixa_versao()
```

The observatory covers `r nrow(IND)` indicators, grouped into six themes, for the 141 municipalities of Mato Grosso (MT). Each indicator page has:

- a **choropleth map** of the 141 municipalities, with classes based on quintiles and X shown in grey;
- a **ranking** within each biome and across Mato Grosso, highlighting the three pilot-area host municipalities;
- a **time series**, where available, for indicators from the Greenhouse Gas Emissions and Removals Estimation System (SEEG);
- aggregates by biome and by Manuscript 1 (M1) type;
- the **full table**, with a column for the symbols used by the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics (IBGE) and an option to download the filtered rows.

Each card shows the value for Mato Grosso: the municipal sum for totals, the ratio of sums for proportions and means, and the change in sums for dynamics indicators. Key indicators carry the [key]{.selo} badge.

```{r}
legenda_sinais()
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
for (d in names(TEMAS)) {
  n <- sum(IND$dim == d)
  cat(sprintf("## %s {#%s}\n\n%s Indicators in this theme: %d.\n\n", TEMAS[[d]], d, TXT_TEMA[[d]], n))
  cat("```{=html}\n", as.character(cartoes_tema(d)), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

## Comparison by biome and by M1 type

The tables below give the aggregates for each indicator in its reference year. Biomes follow the IBGE 1:250,000 map (2019) and types follow the Manuscript 1 typology (k = 5), whose labels are provisional. In groups with X, the aggregate covers only municipalities with a published value.

::: {.panel-tabset}
